name: problem-explorer
description: Explorer badges with real-time diagnostics from your favorite tools (tsc, eslint) plus the editor's own diagnostics.

problemExplorer.enabled.description: Master switch. When disabled, no badges are shown and no scans run.

problemExplorer.showWarnings.description: Show badges for files with only warnings/info. When false, only error-bearing files get badges.

problemExplorer.badgeStyle.description: Badge style: E/W/I letters, per-severity counts, a dot, or none.

problemExplorer.ignorePatterns.description: Glob patterns of files/folders to skip (no badges, no auto-scans).

problemExplorer.errorColor.description: Legacy: use the workbench color problemExplorer.errorForeground instead.

problemExplorer.warningColor.description: Legacy: use the workbench color problemExplorer.warningForeground instead.

problemExplorer.infoColor.description: Legacy: use the workbench color problemExplorer.infoForeground instead.

problemExplorer.severityOverrides.description: Per-file-extension severity overrides applied to editor diagnostics, e.g. { ".py": { "Error": "Warning" } }.

problemExplorer.autoScan.enabled.description: Automatically scan saved files with the enabled providers.

problemExplorer.autoScanDelay.description: Debounce window (ms) between a file change and a scan request.

problemExplorer.debug.description: Verbose trace logging to the Problem Explorer output channel.

problemExplorer.typescript.enabled.description: Enable the TypeScript scanner (tsc --noEmit project scans).

problemExplorer.typescript.scanOnStartup.description: Run a full TypeScript scan when the workspace opens.

problemExplorer.typescript.timeout.description: Max time (ms) for a single tsc scan before it is killed.

problemExplorer.typescript.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the tsc scan command.

problemExplorer.eslint.scanOnStartup.description: Run a full ESLint scan when the workspace opens.

problemExplorer.eslint.timeout.description: Max time (ms) for a single eslint scan before it is killed.

problemExplorer.eslint.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the eslint scan command.

scripts.test:electron: pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/ensure-test-cjs.mjs && node dist/test/runTest.js
scripts.test:electron:packaged: node scripts/build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node ../../scripts/ensure-test-cjs.mjs && pnpm run package && node dist/test/runTestPackaged.js
